name: Instagram Feed Post
text_overlay_rules: Avoid heavy text on the image. Let the duck be clear and close.
caption_structure: Hook, product/use-case detail, question or CTA, hashtags.
asset_requirements: Clear product photo, cropped for mobile, no cluttered background.
example_layout: Product closeup first, optional detail image second.
reuse_notes: Use for product spotlights, gift prompts, and collector questions.
